input.question: How do counterfeit bill detection pens work?
input.ground_truth: Sort of poorly. They put an ink with iodine in it on the note, and if the note is made of something like paper, starches in it will react with the iodine and brown. If the note is made with a cotton base, like an authentic note, it will not react and tend to be colorless. Of course, if the note is fake but based on cotton, it won't detect it. Additionally, numerous methods exist to make fake notes non-reactive to the pens, or to disguise cheap bills as more expensive bills which will also pass muster, being made from an authentic base.
